d:
Miles apart, but always in each other's hearts Watch Vich Pardesan by Jassi Gill from the album Replay (Return Of Melody), starring Jassi Gill and Neeru Bajwa, with lyrics by Sucha Minto and music by Desi Routz.
Jassi Gill's soulful voice and the lovely Jassi–Neeru pairing bring this melodious Punjabi love song to life, a favourite for anyone whose heart is waiting for someone far away
Song - Vich Pardesan
Album - Replay (Return Of Melody)
Artist - Jassi Gill
Starring - Jassi Gill & Neeru Bajwa
Lyrics - Sucha Minto
Music - Desi Routz
